# Primitive Systems

> An agentic component library for Primitive 8 apps. 50+ components, one definition each, generated for Astro, Next.js (React/TSX), Svelte, Tailwind, plain HTML and SCSS, plus a short <p8-*> tag form. Use it instead of hand-writing UI.

## Use it

- MCP (remote): https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/mcp
- HTTP API: https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/api (components, code, compose, search, rules, tokens, theme, lint, install)
- Runtime: <script src="https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/p8.js"></script> then <p8-button variant="primary">Save</p8-button>
- CLI: npx primitive add button --framework react
- Skill for Claude Code: https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/skill/SKILL.md
- Rule book: https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/RULEBOOK.md
- Check book: https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/CHECKBOOK.md
- Agent instructions: https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/AGENTS.md
- Changelog: https://primitive-systems.vercel.app/CHANGELOG.md

## Agent workflow

1. get_rules  2. search_components  3. get_component (read the guidelines)  4. get_code or compose_code  5. lint_code on your changes

Icons come only from https://factory.primitive8.cc/icons
